name: Slide Decks, Web UI & Cards / 演示稿与界面卡片
description: Catch AI UI palette clichés, hero buzzwords, emoji clusters, and slide word-walls in decks and web pages.

rules.description: Default AI-generated purple/indigo/pink Tailwind or CSS gradient palette
Generic SaaS landing-page AI hero slogan
Decorative AI emoji cluster (sparkles, rockets, fire)
Unfinished placeholder copy left in deliverable

exemplars.bad: ✨ Supercharge Your Content Workflow with Our Next-Generation AI-Powered Platform 🚀
exemplars.good: Check prose, layout bounds, and slide density before you ship a document.
exemplars.rationale: Name the concrete input and check performed instead of promising vague transformation.
